item.title: 52 Restaurants 2026: 52 weeks, one delicious year
item.description: From casual, everyday spots, to fine dining, here's your weekly guide to the top spots in Metro Milwaukee for 2026.

item.title: Bucks Week Ahead: Deadline week
item.description: The Bucks have three games at Fiserv Forum this week, but the most important date on the calendar is Thursday, with the NBA trade deadline looming.

item.title: Mount Pleasant house for sale was designed by Wright apprentice Edgar Tafel
item.description: The Edgar Tafel-designed Henry and Gladys Nelsen Usonian-style house in Mount Pleasant is on the market. Here's it's story.

item.title: Urban spelunking: Russell Barr Williamson's Prairie Style bungalows
item.description: For all his talent and celebrity, Frank Lloyd Wright wasn't able to make a success of his early attempt to create a successful system for building affordable houses. That his former protege Russell Barr Williamson went on to work on the same endeavor would surely have rankled the curmudgeonly and egotistical Wright.

item.title: Deer District to launch new Sunday farmers market this summer
item.description: Weekly market will feature 100+ vendors, live music, family activities and farm-fresh foods.

item.title: Lineup announced for 2026 Thiensville Eats & Beats Concert Series
item.description: The 2026 lineup has been announced for Thiensville's Eats & Beats Concert Series, which combines live music, food trucks, drinks and more at Thiensville Village Park during the summer.

item.title: Drink a Bloody Mary & do some good: The Wicked Hop gives back all February long
item.description: The Historic Third Ward favorite is donating $1 from every Bloody Mary sold to support services for Milwaukee's homeless and runaway youth.

item.title: Accessing winter fun at Wehr Nature Center
item.description: Living in Wisconsin, we have three choices when winter arrives: we can flee, we can hibernate or we can get outside and embrace the season. There's no better place to do the latter than at Wehr Nature Center.

item.title: Stamp over to Snail Mail stationery market for valentines and more
item.description: This Saturday, Anodyne Coffee in Walker's Point will once again host Snail Mail, an artist-run market selling everything you need to correspond the old-fashioned way.

item.title: M'waukee's most mispronounced, misused words
item.description: In honor of OnMilwaukee's upcoming Adult Spelling Bee, we're highlighting our local dialect: the mispronunciations, the phrases and the abbreviations that only make sense in Brew City.
